ideas.pitch: An AI-powered cloud server and application log analysis dashboard with real-time anomaly detection tailored for student deployments.
ideas.title: CloudLogix AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning NGINX log analysis pattern and directly targets the cloud computing and AI tracks popular in college hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An ethical telemetry and governance platform for monitoring student-built AI applications and API call costs.
ideas.title: GovGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the governance and telemetry win pattern by giving judges a concrete tool for monitoring LLM compliance and usage.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router for optimizing LLM queries and lowering API expenses in student projects.
ideas.title: SemRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the 1st prize Superlinked x Qwen hackathon strategy by solving high API costs with a clever engineering approach.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool for automated software pipelines and student cloud workflows.
ideas.title: BPMN Risk Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the UiPath AgentHack winning blueprint, combining business process modeling with agentic risk analysis.

ideas.pitch: An efficient reasoning wrapper for LLMs that optimizes complex academic and data science queries using reinforcement patterns.
ideas.title: HyperReason Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the OpenAI/Jetbrains hackathon winning approach of making models think faster and cheaper for specific domains.
